name: Tahir Abdullayev
event: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
summary: An Azerbaijani welterweight nicknamed 'Tank' (20-3 in our data; LowKick lists 22-3; age 30) who debuted in the UFC in June in Baku with a R3 TKO of the previously unbeaten Jefferson Nascimento. A stoppage-heavy regional record: 18 of his 20 wins are finishes. He replaced Akbar Abdullaev as Jake Matthews's opponent after a reported matchmaking mix-up.

how_they_fight.Striking: Forward-walking pressure fighter. Against Nascimento he struggled to cut off the cage and kept biting on feints, and was outlanded in R2 as he came forward (Cageside, LowKick). Eleven KO/TKO wins, seven of them in R1, but UFC sample is one fight: 37 of 87 significant strikes landed against 35.
how_they_fight.Grappling: The UFC finish came from wrestling: an early R3 takedown, then well-timed takedowns whenever Nascimento opened up, and heavy punches and hammerfists from top (Cageside). Seven submission wins on the regional scene. About 1.7 takedowns per 15 at 35%.
how_they_fight.Defense: Takes some counters on the way in (Nascimento's right hands and leg kicks, per LowKick). Never stopped by strikes. His three losses: a 2018 R2 submission to Roman Bogatov (M-1) and two five-round decisions at UAE Warriors (Josh Togo 2022, Khotam Boynazarov 2024). Takedown defense about 67%.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Mostly an early finisher: of 18 stoppage wins, 10 came in R1, 6 in R2 and 2 in R3. The UFC debut was a slow build, though, with a quiet R1 and a finish at 4:28 of R3, so he can keep pressing for 15 minutes. Both five-round fights went to the judges and he lost both, which hints he is less effective over long fights.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Patient enough to switch to wrestling once striking wasn't working (Cageside). Footwork and range control were the weak points in his debut. The stoppage was criticised as early: Cageside said only a few hammerfists were landing, and Nascimento protested right away (LowKick).

patterns: Pressure forward, then shoots when the opponent opens up
18 of 20 wins by stoppage; 10 in R1
Lost both of his five-round fights on points
concerns: Only one UFC fight, and its stoppage was disputed
Struggled to cut off a mobile opponent and bit on feints
Record differs by source (20-3 in our data, 22-3 per LowKick)
Short build-up: booked in place of Akbar Abdullaev
keys_to_beat: Move and counter as he walks in; he has trouble cutting off the cage
Defend the takedown when throwing combinations; he times shots off opponents' offense
Threaten from bottom; his ground-and-pound leaves openings for submissions

news.text: Replaces Akbar Abdullaev against Jake Matthews; Wikipedia says the first pairing was the promotion's mistake. Listed on the UFC.com prelims.
UFC debut in Baku: TKO of Jefferson Nascimento at 4:28 of R3 after takedowns and hammerfists; Cageside called the stoppage early.
